content:
Ahead of Friday's shipping date, we've rounded up the iPhone 18 Pro accessories we'll be buying for ourselves this year. Ask me, and Apple's AirTag 2 and the new AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are absolutely the best accessories to pair with the new iPhone 18 Pro, not to mention the world's finest polishing cloth — but this time we wanted to dig a little deeper: chargers, MagSafe stands, cases, wallets and more. Take a look at the introductions below.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance — Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max
  • Ben — Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael — Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin — Apple iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
  • Ryan — iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Car Mount
  • Fernando — Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra Slim Charger
  • Simon — Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Adapter
  • Justin — Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
  • Reinette — Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Clear Case
  • Some other favourites of ours

If you want to charge your new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max as quickly as possible, you need a compatible charging brick. Specifically, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply — and Apple's offering is currently the best around. It features a compact, foldable design and can charge your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% in just 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven case pairs an attractive look with a superb in-hand feel, equipped with distinctly tactile anodised aluminium buttons and available in a range of deep, rich colours — all designed with the eco credentials of being made from 100% recycled polyester.

Anker's compact 3-in-1 wireless charger can power three devices simultaneously through a single, portable accessory, and delivers MagSafe-compatible Qi2 wireless charging for your iPhone. It folds down to an incredibly small size and slips easily into a travel bag, making it a great way to cut down on the number of cables and adapters you carry on the go — or to keep your entire Apple device array neatly arranged on a bedside table or desk. And it happens to be nearly 35% off today, setting an all-time low on Amazon.

Apple's FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe has long been a must-have iPhone accessory for those chasing a minimalist aesthetic. It comfortably holds 3 to 4 cards, making it perfect for an ID, a couple of credit cards or keycards, and is ideal for anyone who doesn't want to lug around a bulky wallet.

Every time I get in the car, I want a secure, stable place to put my iPhone. The ESR MagSafe car mount is my top pick. You can magnetically attach your iPhone 18 Pro or older models to the mount, which conveniently clips onto your vehicle's air vent. The MagSafe mount keeps your iPhone secure while keeping the screen in view and charging continuously while you drive — three birds with one stone.

I've always believed that the MagSafe power bank you use day-to-day with your iPhone should be as thin as possible. Baseus has happened to release what I consider the perfect MagSafe battery. The Picogo Air is just 0.27 inches thin and weighs only 3.7 ounces. It packs a 5,000mAh battery, delivers up to 7.5W wirelessly, and up to 22.5W over wired charging. Best of all, the company has released a colourway that perfectly complements the new Burgundy iPhone. This is how a MagSafe battery should be designed — thin and light above all else.

If you travel frequently, you already know that keeping your tech bag tidy is half the battle. That's why I always keep an eye out for all-in-one charging gear. This Baseus travel adapter fits the bill perfectly, supporting outlets in over 200 countries and featuring a design that can power six devices at once. However, what really catches my eye is the built-in retractable 70W USB-C cable, which not only charges the iPhone 18 Pro at full speed but also delivers stable charging performance for iPads, MacBooks and more.

I recommended the pick Michael made above — which I personally think is the best travel-friendly foldable MagSafe charger on the market right now — but I'm more drawn to my two favourite desktop 3-in-1 models: the strikingly sleek and minimalist 25W Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand in a beautiful Space Black finish; and Anker's Smart Display 3-in-1 model, which I also quite like, but the Satechi is just so elegant, with a refined, understated beauty that's simply unmatched.

After spending the money on an iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually look for more affordable options when it comes to accessories rather than chasing the most premium offerings, and Spigen has plenty of budget-friendly MagSafe cases. My top pick is the Ultra Hybrid MagFit Clear Case, which is far cheaper than the competition, or its opaque multicoloured version — both are MagSafe models that support fast wireless charging. They also feature DuraClear side TPU panels infused with blue resin to prevent yellowing, along with shock-absorbing design, and notably, the camera control button is also covered by a thin layer of TPU for protection.

  • AirTag 2
  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger
  • Beats Woven USB-C Cable
  • All-new Pitaka Burgundy MagSafe Aramid Fibre iPhone 18 Pro Case
  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
  • Nomad Find My Tracking Card
